body:
- [ ] I am using the latest released version of Numba (most recent is visible in
 the change log (https://github.com/numba/numba/blob/master/CHANGE_LOG).
- [ ] I have included below a minimal working reproducer (if you are unsure how
 to write one see http://matthewrocklin.com/blog/work/2018/02/28/minimal-bug-reports).

I would prefer to have the following info, maybe also in the cudatoolkit, so that users with low end cards can see why 'cuda' is not so fast as expected (single vs double speed, device - host speed) or why the kernel is 'crashing' (watchdog/TDR "windows feature")

From CUDA-Z utility:
Watchdog Enabled : Yes / No
Compute Mode : Default or TCC
Performance: Host to Device; Device to Host; Host to Host; Single-precision float; Double-precision float;

Fron Nsight Monitor: WDDM TDR Delay; WDDM TDR Enabled
title: numba.cuda.detect() feature request
